name: Joumuin ~Sora no Seidorei~
source:
Main character dreamed of becoming a pilot and got a job at an airline company. However, he also turned out to be a playboy to set sex traps for stewardesses and pilot candidates. As his schemes are revealed, he is only gets transferred to another plane. As his boss explains, company wants to nurture stewardesses to provide sexual entertainment and thus save the company from rivals' damping.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-april-2005-sanarara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
